name: AngelList
description:
Fund managers spend too much time on lookups that should be instant: capital call status, LP holdings, valuations, documents. AngelList MCP puts your entire fund at the other end of a prompt. Authenticate once to query capital accounts, distributions, and documents across every vehicle, backed by financials that refresh daily instead of once a quarter. It's the system of record your fund already runs on, now queryable from wherever you work.

Every answer comes with a path back to its source — ask for the underlying document to verify on your terms. Investment decisions get made on current numbers, LP questions get answered on the spot, and the workflows that used to take an email chain are handled in a single prompt. AngelList runs more of a fund's operations than any other platform — formation, banking, capital calls, distributions, taxes, reporting. AngelList MCP makes all of it queryable from wherever you work.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AngelList to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AngelList to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.angellist.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AngelList MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AngelList lists 28 MCP tools, including download_document, get_capital_account, get_capital_call, get_close, get_company, get_deployment, get_distribution, get_document, get_financial_statement, get_firm, get_me, and get_rolling_fund.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AngelList?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AngelList in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
AngelList requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AngelList is developed by AngelList. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
